intro.slide1Body: Restaurants, bakeries and shops near you sell their extra food at a big discount before closing.
intro.slide2Title: Reserve and pay in the app
intro.slide2Body: Pick an offer, pay with eSewa or Khalti, and get a pickup code.
intro.slide3Body: Show your code at the shop during the pickup time. Happy hour deals are shown too.
